connector.registryDescription: Geolocation tools (reverse geocoding, ip lookup, etc) using Jeleo Geolocation API
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image geolocation-mcp:v1.0.0. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wtronk account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
